note: The shared statement of what may never appear in a published Companion profile. This file is carried byte-identically by auto-pigeon-backend (internal/companionprofile) and auto-pigeon-companion (internal/profile); each repository asserts its OWN implementation against it and pins this file's SHA-256, so an edit to one copy fails that repository's tests immediately. Each case is a JSON value the scan walks; `portable` is the verdict both implementations must reach.

cases.name: an ordinary document says nothing about a machine
a posix absolute path is somebody's own disk
a windows drive path is the same mistake spelled differently
a UNC share is a location as well as a path
a protocol-relative URL is a location
a home reference differs per user on the same machine
a loopback name means the reader's own machine
a loopback address is the same claim as a number
a private address is one LAN's answer and nobody else's
an addressed public IP literal is still an address
an authorization header pasted into prose
a session token pasted into prose
a PEM private key
a URL carrying credentials
a fault inside an array is still a fault
a fault nested three deep is still a fault
an ordinary https homepage is what a profile is for
a four-component version is not an IP address
an SPDX identifier is not a path
a relative executable is exactly what a profile should say
one slash is punctuation, not a filesystem location
an environment variable name is not a secret
a number and a boolean carry nothing to scan
an empty string is not a fault
